title: Contributing
text: We welcome contributions to ACS.jl! Here's how you can help:

title: Types of Contributions
text: Bug reportsFeature requestsDocumentation improvementsCode contributionsExamples and tutorials

title: Development Setup
text: Fork the repositoryClone your fork:git clone https://github.com/technocrat/ACS.jl.gitAdd the original repository as upstream:git remote add upstream https://github.com/originalowner/ACS.jl.gitCreate a new branch for your changes:git checkout -b feature-name

title: Running Tests
text:
using Pkg
Pkg.test("ACS")

title: Documentation
text: Documentation is built using Documenter.jlBuild the documentation locally:include("docs/make.jl")Preview the documentation in your browser at docs/build/index.html

title: Code Style Guidelines
text: Follow Julia's style guideUse meaningful variable namesAdd docstrings for all public functionsInclude examples in docstringsWrite tests for new functionality

title: Submitting Changes
text:
Commit your changes:git add .
git commit -m "Description of changes"Push to your fork:git push origin feature-nameCreate a Pull Request from your fork to the main repository

title: Code Review Process
text: All contributions require reviewAddress any feedback from maintainersKeep pull requests focused on a single changeMaintain a clean commit history

title: Getting Help
text: Open an issue for questionsJoin our community discussionsRead the existing documentation

title: Getting Population Estimates
text:
using CensusACS

# Get total population for all states using 5-year estimates
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state"
)

# Get population and median household income
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E", "B19013_001E"],
    geography = "state"
)

title: Working with Margins of Error
text:
# Get MOE for total population
df_moe = get_acs_moe(
    variables = ["B01003_001M"],
    geography = "state"
)

title: State Level
text:
# Get state-level data
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state"
)

title: County Level
text:
# Get all counties in California
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "county",
    state = "CA"
)

title: Census Tract Level
text:
# Get all tracts in a specific county
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "tract",
    state = "CA",
    county = "001"  # Alameda County
)

title: 1-Year Estimates
text:
# Get 1-year estimates (65,000+ population areas only)
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state",
    survey = "acs1"
)

title: 3-Year Estimates
text:
# Get 3-year estimates from 2013 (20,000+ population areas)
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state",
    year = 2013,
    survey = "acs3"
)

title: 5-Year Estimates
text:
# Get 5-year estimates (all areas)
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state",
    survey = "acs5"
)

title: Error Handling
text:
The package includes robust error handling for common scenarios: # Invalid year for 3-year estimates
try
    df = get_acs(
        variables = ["B01003_001E"],
        geography = "state",
        year = 2020,
        survey = "acs3"
    )
catch e
    println("Error: ", e)
end

title: CensusACS.jl Documentation
text: Welcome to the documentation for CensusACS.jl, a Julia package for retrieving data from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS) API.

title: Overview
text: CensusACS.jl provides a simple and robust interface to access American Community Survey data through the Census Bureau's API. The package supports: Data retrieval from 1-year, 3-year, and 5-year ACS estimatesVarious geographic levels (state, county, tract, block group)Automatic handling of state …

title: Quick Start
text:
using CensusACS

# Set your Census API key
ENV["CENSUS_API_KEY"] = "your-api-key-here"

# Get total population estimates for all states (5-year ACS)
df = get_acs(
    variables = ["B01003_001E"],
    geography = "state"
)

title: Installation
text:
using Pkg
Pkg.add("CensusACS")

title: Survey Types
text: 5-year estimates (2009-present)3-year estimates (2007-2013)1-year estimates (2005-present, except 2020)

title: Geographic Levels
text: StateCountyCensus tractBlock group

title: Data Types
text: Estimates (variables ending in 'E')Margins of error (variables ending in 'M')

title: Census API Key
text: To use this package, you need a Census API key. You can obtain one at: https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html

title: Contributing
text: Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit issues or pull requests on our GitHub repository.
